name: DAMPE
summary: China's Dark Matter Particle Explorer satellite searches high-resolution electron–positron and gamma-ray spectra for indirect dark-matter features while measuring high-energy cosmic rays.
detection_principle: Plastic scintillators identify charge and provide anticoincidence, a silicon–tungsten tracker measures direction, a BGO calorimeter measures shower energy, and a neutron detector assists electron–hadron separation.

status.label: Operation supported by evidence

key_parameters.value: 308 crystals in 14 layers with alternating orientations

science_scope: Tests dark-matter models through astrophysical radiation, cosmic rays or neutrinos. Astrophysical backgrounds and propagation models affect interpretation; an anomaly alone does not establish dark matter.
